title: Florges cs4aC 067/132 Rare Holo S-Chinese Pokemon TCG
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and highly sought-after Florges card is a must-have for any serious Pokémon TCG collector. With its stunning holo design and powerful abilities, this Stage 2 card is sure to impress both experienced players and beginners alike. Featuring the beloved character Florges, this card is made from high-quality cardstock and has been crafted with care in China by The Pokémon Company International. 

The card is part of the 9 Colors Gathering edition and has the card number 067/132. It is a Holo Rare and comes in Simplified Chinese language. The card is perfect for players aged 6 and above and is sure to add a touch of magic to any Pokémon TCG game. Don't miss out on your chance to own this rare and beautiful Florges card!
